visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: XOR Instead of a Search per Candidate
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Every candidate number is searched for in the array with indexOf. Use XOR: values that appear twice cancel out and leave the missing number. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: x ^ x is 0 and x ^ 0 is x, so XOR-ing every index and every value (plus n) leaves the missing number. It takes one pass instead of a search for every candidate.
